summary: Legacy base modes, redstone control, scoped trust management and textured base GUIs are restored through session-bound server-authoritative menus and payloads.

authoritative_state: Base mode, redstone signal, effective active state, targeting settings, statistics and trust scope are server-owned.
Trust membership, access levels and revisions are mutated only after validating the currently open base menu.

flows.purpose: Apply a bounded base setting or destructive owner action to the currently open base.
validation: containerId, menu type, position, dimension, distance, loaded BlockEntity identity and stillValid must match.
Command operands and required VIEW, USE or ADMIN access are validated per command.

flows.purpose: Request or mutate a bounded local or global trust list for the current menu session.
validation: The request is bound to the current base menu session.
Only local ADMIN may mutate local trust and only the owner may mutate global trust.
Names, UUIDs, access ids, operations, revisions and the 64-entry limit are strict.

flows.purpose: Return a bounded, revisioned authoritative trust snapshot for one menu session and scope.
validation: Client menu containerId, position, owner and scope must match.
Snapshots with a revision older than the current scope revision are ignored.

client_boundary.dedicated_server_fallback: All base and trust behavior remains available without loading screen classes.

generated: en_us and zh_cn base control, mode, trust and tooltip translations
manual: Preserved configure, trusted players and inventory expander textures

budgets.measurement: Codec and server snapshot construction both reject or cap entries before allocation.

performance.measurement_environment: Java 21, NeoForge 21.1.234 client and GameTest server.

mods.fallback: The mod refuses to load outside the pinned NeoForge 21.1 line.

criteria.statement: BlockEntity v1/v2/v3 and Memory Card schema 1/2/3 mode migration.
criteria.observation: Loading schema 1, 2 and 3 base fixtures and schema 1, 2 and 3 Memory Card profiles yields the documented mode, owner and access state without reset or privilege gain.

criteria.statement: Four-mode truth table, redstone changes, stable ids and v2/v3 persistence.
criteria.observation: For each stable mode id, toggling the neighboring redstone signal produces the documented active state before and after save and reload.

criteria.statement: Session binding, operand bounds, permission matrix and destructive commands.
criteria.observation: A matching open-menu session accepts bounded authorized commands, while wrong session, position, distance, operand or access leaves the base unchanged; destructive commands affect only the validated base.

criteria.statement: NONE membership, local/global scope, owner-only global writes, no-op revisions and caps.
criteria.observation: Local and global trust mutations expose the documented membership and access levels, reject unauthorized global writes and over-cap inserts, and increment revisions only when state changes.

criteria.statement: Initial snapshot, 64-entry bound, stable order, session key and monotonic revision reducer.
criteria.observation: Opening a trust page returns at most 64 entries in stable order, and snapshots with the wrong session key or an older revision do not replace the visible page.

criteria.statement: Codec and snapshot construction enforce the 64-entry allocation bound.
criteria.observation: Encoding, decoding and server construction reject or cap a trust snapshot before more than 64 entries are materialized or transmitted.

criteria.statement: GUI textures and all locale keys resolve.
criteria.observation: The asset gate resolves every base GUI texture and every en_us and zh_cn key referenced by the base and trust screens.

criteria.statement: No screen or client snapshot class is loaded on a dedicated server.
criteria.observation: A dedicated server reaches its ready state without loading any class from the base screen or client trust-snapshot packages.

criteria.statement: The open base menu round-trips every synchronized ContainerData field without truncating integers or long statistics.
criteria.observation: After server values cross their low and high 32-bit boundaries, the open menu exposes the same tier, mode, flags, access, energy and full-width kill, player-kill and shot counters.

steps: Open all five base tiers at GUI scales 1 through 4, including a 320 by 240 logical canvas.
Inspect energy at 0, 50 and 100 percent and every permission level.
Cycle every redstone control mode slowly and with rapid consecutive clicks while separately observing signal and effective running state.
Exercise both range buttons slowly and with rapid consecutive clicks before and after attaching turrets with different maximum ranges.
Open targeting and local/global trust pages and perform add, remove and level changes.
manual_checks.expected: Slots align with preserved textures; overview text does not overlap controls; redstone mode, signal and effective running state are unambiguous; controls do not overflow and server state is reflected after every action.

non_goals: Camouflage block rendering and light sliders
